title: Research report on three ways to read the formula

plain: One of the first pieces of research Bryce Zabel and his collaborators got back on a certain formula was a report of about 20 pages that broke it into three main ways to interpret it. Zabel, a guest on an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, describes the report himself, without naming who wrote it, as an early attempt to make sense of what the formula meant.
